explanation: Independent review accepts the Survey/Questionnaire Acquisition and future KU2A SEM architecture assessment. The proposed separation between public Internet acquisition, authorized existing-system connectors, survey/primary collection, and KU2A analytical/SEM responsibilities is coherent. Google Forms is correctly treated as a provider adapter rather than the domain model; questionnaire design, sampling design, and experimental design are kept distinct; respondent data is explicitly excluded from Learning Memory and coordination artifacts; and SEM is placed in KU2A with measurement metadata handed off from KU2D. No implementation or human authority decision is required in this review step.
